Listen to 9to5Mac's roundup of today's top news on the podcast. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and the Apple Podcasts app, Stitcher, TuneIn, and Google Play, and can also be streamed via our dedicated RSS feed on Overcast or other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you move all your ideas from your mind into a simple, elegant system—clear your to-do list and reduce mental clutter. A simple to-do list designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make organising, tracking, and completing tasks more satisfying. Get Stuff done.

New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player, and new episodes will be delivered straight to your ears as soon as they're released.

News stories discussed in this episode:

  • Following Trump's executive order, Apple Maps replaces 'Lake Ontario' with 'Lake America'
  • Apple's executive reshuffle continues as John Ternus takes over as CEO
  • Compensation revealed for John Ternus as CEO and Tim Cook as Executive Chairman
  • Full text of the internal memo John Ternus sent to Apple employees on his first day as CEO
